title: Taik-Frames
tagline: A frame made where users can see the hackathons at the taikai platform
description: Farcaster is revolutionizing the web3 social networks. So I have made a frame for the users to use. The Frame which I have made allows users to visit the taikai platform and view the hackathons and then take part in it. It is easy for the users as they can carry on their work in the same page while scrolling the same page.
how_its_made: Farcaster is revolutionizing the web3 social networks. So I have made a frame for the users to use. The Frame which I have made allows users to visit the taikai platform and view the hackathons and then take part in it. It is easy for the users as they can carry on their work in the same page while scrolling the same page. It is made using the html language and the xmtp protocol.
